comparisons.name: panel-light
comparisons.description: The silent panel beside the TextEdit window with 12 pt of the desktop around it, Aqua. The desktop picture cannot be reproduced: the example paints the sky as a gradient through colours measured clear of the panel, and an element at its right edge stands for the window, whose shadow falls on the gap. The crop's origin is odd so that the panel, which sits on odd pixels, is on whole points.

comparisons.name: panel-light-drawing
comparisons.description: As panel-light with the title of Done masked, to score the drawing alone: the title is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms. Most of the mean difference is the fill: the shared menu material gives #c3def0 over this sky where the capture measures #bde4f8.

comparisons.name: panel-dark
comparisons.description: The panel beside the TextEdit window, at the level the capture shows, with 12 pt of the desktop around it, Dark Aqua. The backdrop stands in for the desktop picture as explained for panel-light.

comparisons.name: panel-dark-drawing
comparisons.description: As panel-dark with the title of Done masked, to score the drawing alone. Part of what differs is the night sky at the left edge, which has clouds where the example has a gradient.
